# Kashmir Glide Tour & Travels

> Government-registered travel agency (Reg. No. JKEA00005750, valid till 31 Dec 2027) based in Iqbal Colony, Tangmarg, Baramulla, Jammu & Kashmir — 193402. Gateway location to Gulmarg.

## About
Kashmir Glide Tour & Travels designs personalised Kashmir tour packages rather than fixed group packages. Founded and run locally in Tangmarg, with guides fluent in Hindi, English, Kashmiri and Urdu. Rated 4.9/5 by 500+ travellers from 20+ Indian states and abroad. 8+ years of experience.

## Services
- Kashmir tour packages (customised, multi-day)
- Gulmarg Gondola Package — 2 days, adventure/skiing, from ₹3,500
- Srinagar Honeymoon Package — 4 days, couples, from ₹12,000
- Pahalgam Valley Explorer — 3 days, family/nature, from ₹8,500
- Cab and car rental service across Kashmir
- Custom trip planning for families, couples and groups
